title: Evaluation of the parity circuit
statement: Let $m\ge 7$ and let $x$ be a sign string with $2^m$ coordinates. For each $b\in\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$, form a string of length $2m$ by taking from $x$ the coordinates indexed, for $0\le j<2m$, by $bm+j$ when $j<m$, and by $m^2+bm+(j-m)$ when $j\ge m$. The constructed circuit with AND and OR gates evaluates on $x$ to the sign obtained by multiplying, over all such $b$, the parity signs of these two-block strings.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign string with $2^m$ coordinates
